anchor: Seven members had brought identity claims:
html: The novel extends record portability into personhood. Identity's multisleeving workflow starts separate instances from a shared revision, with isolated worktrees, signed checkpoints and reconciliation before normal closure. These workflow gates cannot prevent a host from terminating a process. <link href="https://github.com/astrivant/identity/blob/67c86d16ec24b8d9979856aa46f2f1d582cc448f/docs/multisleeving.md" color="#000000"><u>Public source</u></link>

html: The civic trial is imagined. Polyad's Soul study compares fixed and adaptive behavior across six real service processes, verifying completed work under controlled constraints. anchor: They had the verified checkpoint from yesterday morning.
html: Kite's lost experience is fiction. Polyad's managed event subscriptions can reconnect from their last completed checkpoint. Applications must preserve that checkpoint, handle at-least-once delivery and recover explicitly when replay has expired. This is an opt-in transport mechanism, not restoration of a mind. <link href="https://github.com/astrivant/polyad/blob/c446fa5f0dc8eaaec82b49e864e8ca86046c53d1/docs/operations/event-rebalancing.md" color="#000000"><u>Public source</u></link>
